title: Same cuff, different meaning: vasopressor dose and arterial hypotension behind an acceptable cuff reading in four ICU databases: analysis code
description: Analysis code and disclosure-controlled aggregate results accompanying the manuscript "Same cuff, different meaning: vasopressor dose and arterial hypotension behind an acceptable cuff reading in four ICU databases". The repository includes extraction and analysis templates for MIMIC-IV, eICU, AmsterdamUMCdb and SICdb, aggregate-reproduction scripts, and figure code. Source patient records, paired observations, identifiers, bootstrap replicates and restricted source-audit evidence are not included. Reproduction of source-data analyses requires separately approved database access. Original software is licensed under MIT; this license does not grant access to the clinical databases or license their records. See README.md and docs/aggregate_release_policy.md for the verified reproduction scope and aggregate disclosure rules.
